data.text: I’m willing to take 18 tons this month under a shared agreement. One adjustment for later: a fixed 10-ton reserve could leave us stuck earning nothing if the stock drops to 10. In low-stock months, let’s each take no more than one-tenth of the available stock, rounded down, so the lake can grow even without external replenishment. We can review that rule together after seeing next month’s stock. John, are you on board with 18 each now?
